path_step: User attempts to view sessions for a course they are not enrolled in.
test_scenario: Verify that a user cannot see sessions for courses they are not enrolled in, adhering to the Session Visibility business rule (BR-CALENDAR-01).
test_case_title: Prevent Viewing Sessions for Unenrolled Courses
pre_condition: A user is logged in and enrolled in Course A (with scheduled sessions). Course B exists and has scheduled sessions, but the user is NOT enrolled in Course B.
expected_result: The user's calendar displays sessions only for Course A. Sessions for Course B are not visible on the calendar, upholding the session visibility rule.
post_condition: The user's calendar correctly reflects sessions only for enrolled courses, and non-enrolled course sessions are hidden.

test_steps.step: Log in as a user who is enrolled in Course A (with sessions) but not Course B (with sessions).
Navigate to the 'Calendar' page from the Dashboard.
Verify that the calendar displays scheduled sessions for Course A.
Verify that no scheduled sessions for Course B are visible on the calendar.

uncovered_conditions: BR-CALENDAR-01: Users can only see the sessions for the courses they are enrolled in (negative case)
